findings.failure_mode: Missing file, permission denied, or unreadable path aborts the entire process instead of returning a typed error
findings.fix: Return Result<Vec<Record>, IoError> (or a domain Io error type) and propagate with ? at the caller boundary

findings.failure_mode: Malformed number field panics the caller; a single bad row crashes the entire frame load
findings.fix: Use checked parse via .map_err() to a typed Parse error, and return Result<Vec<Record>, ParseError> so each row failure is handled gracefully

findings.problem: as u16 cast from u32 parse result is lossy; values >65535 silently truncate
findings.failure_mode: A valid u32 in range 65536..=4294967295 truncates to a wrong u16 instead of producing an overflow error, corrupting the data silently
findings.fix: Use u16::try_from(parts[1_parsed]) with map_err to a TypedError::ValueOverflow, or parse directly as u16 via parts[1].parse::<u16>()

findings.problem: parts[0] accessed without bounds check on split result
findings.failure_mode: Empty line or line with no comma yields empty parts Vec; index out of bounds panic
findings.fix: Use split_once(',') and handle None (missing comma) gracefully, or use .get(0) with ok_or/unwrap_or_else returning a typed Parse error for malformed rows

findings.failure_mode: Line with only one comma-separated field (e.g. "name,") yields parts[1] as empty string or panics if fewer than 2 fields exist
findings.fix: Use split_once(',') and .get(1) or pattern-match on the two-field result, returning a typed Parse error for missing fields

findings.problem: load_frames mixes I/O (fs::read_to_string) with parsing logic in a single function that also contains println! (side effect at line 16)
findings.failure_mode: Cannot unit-test the parsing logic in isolation; logging is coupled to data transformation, violating pure-core principle and making behavior non-deterministic across environments
findings.fix: Extract pure parsing into a separate fn parse_record(&str) -> Result<Record, ParseError> with no I/O or logging. Shell layer calls fs::read_to_string, feeds lines to the pure parser, and handles side effects (logging) separately

findings.problem: println!() side effect inside data-processing function
findings.failure_mode: Non-deterministic output; side effects leak into pure calculation path, making tests environment-dependent and breaking functional-core purity
findings.fix: Remove println! from the parser. If logging is needed, push it to the shell layer outside the pure transformation, or accept a callback/logger parameter explicitly

findings.problem: Vec<String> allocation for split parts without try_reserve or known capacity
findings.failure_mode: Unbounded allocation on untrusted input; malformed lines with many commas can trigger excessive heap growth with no graceful allocation-failure handling
findings.fix: For a known two-field grammar, use split_once(',') instead of collecting all parts. If collecting is needed, use try_reserve with checked capacity and map allocation failure to a typed error

findings.problem: Record uses raw String and u16 instead of domain newtypes with invariants
findings.failure_mode: No compile-time guarantee that name is non-empty or value is in valid domain range; any code can construct an invalid Record
findings.fix: Introduce newtype wrappers (e.g. RecordName(String) with non-empty invariant, RecordValue(u16)) and a fallible constructor fn Record::try_new(name: &str, value: u16) -> Result<Self, InvalidRecord>

findings.problem: No benchmark, profiler, or allocation evidence exists for the frame-loading path
findings.failure_mode: Cannot verify performance claims or allocation behavior; hidden allocations from String::to_string() on every split field are unmeasured
findings.fix: Add a benchmark (e.g. criterion) measuring parse throughput, allocation count, and memory for representative input sizes

findings.problem: No cargo test, cargo fmt, or cargo clippy evidence present in crate
findings.failure_mode: Compilation correctness, formatting compliance, and lint hygiene are unverified
findings.fix: Run cargo fmt && cargo test && cargo clippy -- -D warnings and record command outcomes
